name: blast-fire-step-visual
description: Redesign P4/#26: the Blast Workshop's Fire step (danger zone, Sound the Horn, pre-flight checklist) and the real fire flow — FIRE opens PreflightModal, DETONATE fires and closes it, BlastReportModal auto-opens with the real report, CLOSE dismisses it.

steps.command: drill_plan grid origin:10,10 rows:1 cols:1 spacing:3 depth:6
steps.description: Setup: a single hole — a complete, valid plan once charged and sequenced below. Split into one step per command (issue #479, same class as Finding #5 in the original #479 plan doc): the bundled 3-command interaction array only ever ran its first command in command mode, since command-runner.ts's runSteps executes step.command alone, not the interaction array.

interaction.command: drill_plan grid origin:10,10 rows:1 cols:1 spacing:3 depth:6

steps.description: sequence set hole:H1 delay:0ms — per-hole delay only reachable via relative +/- steppers, not a set-to-value click (Finding #9). Left as a command.

Opening the Blast Workshop auto-lands on step 5 (Fire) since the plan is complete — the danger zone shows clear (nobody nearby), Sound the Horn is disabled, and the pre-flight checklist reads all-clear
FIRE opens PreflightModal — real plan stats, the 'run analysis' hint (no preview has run), and the all-clear warnings
DETONATE fires the blast, closes PreflightModal, and BlastReportModal auto-opens with the real report (rating, cleared/cracked/fragments, ore value)

expect.note: a fired blast clears the plan back to zero
the report modal must hide once closed, same invariant as BlastReportModal's other conversions
